title: Demo shop overview
description: Is the demo shop healthy: traffic, orders, its database, and what checkout's logs and traces say.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Requests per second the frontend answered, the traffic customers send.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of frontend requests that ended with a 5xx status.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile time the frontend took to answer a request.

panels.title: Orders processed
panels.description: Orders the checkout workers took off the queue and completed, per minute.

panels.title: Orders waiting

panels.title: Database pool in use
panels.description: Share of inventory database connections held by a query, across all pods.

queries.query: (sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="shop",status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="shop"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (route) (rate(http_requests_total{job="shop"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Orders processed per minute by result
Pool connections in use by pod
Product cache hit ratio by service

queries.query: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, SeverityText AS severity, count() AS lines FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

SELECT if(mapContains(LogAttributes, 'result'), concat(Body, ' (result ', LogAttributes['result'], ')'), Body) AS message, count() AS lines FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SeverityText = 'ERROR' GROUP BY message ORDER BY lines DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, if(mapContains(LogAttributes, 'result'), concat(Body, ' (result ', LogAttributes['result'], ')'), Body) AS Body, TraceId FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SeverityText = 'ERROR' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS p95 FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SpanName = 'POST /checkout' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT Timestamp AS time, TraceId AS trace_id, Duration / 1e6 AS duration_ms, StatusCode AS status FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SpanName = 'POST /checkout' ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: How are requests and load spread out?
Busiest database pool
panels.description: Share of connections held by a query on the most loaded pod.

queries.query: SELECT Duration / 1e6 AS duration_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SpanName = 'POST /checkout' LIMIT 5000

SELECT toFloat64(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['order_id'])) AS order_id, toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['queue_wait_ms']) AS queue_wait_ms FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND Body = 'order processed' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT toFloat64(intDiv(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['queue_wait_ms']), 100) * 100) AS queue_wait_ms, count() AS orders FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND Body = 'order processed' GROUP BY queue_wait_ms ORDER BY queue_wait_ms

panels.title: Checkout request time every 5 minutes
panels.description: Each candle is five minutes of checkout requests: first and last duration, with the fastest and slowest as the wicks.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, toFloat64(argMin(Duration, Timestamp)) / 1e6 AS open, toFloat64(max(Duration)) / 1e6 AS high, toFloat64(min(Duration)) / 1e6 AS low, toFloat64(argMax(Duration, Timestamp)) / 1e6 AS close FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'checkout' AND SpanName = 'POST /checkout' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Where does a checkout spend its time?

queries.query: SELECT concat(p.ServiceName, ' -> ', c.ServiceName) AS id, p.ServiceName AS source, c.ServiceName AS target, count() AS mainstat FROM otel_traces AS c INNER JOIN otel_traces AS p ON c.ParentSpanId = p.SpanId AND c.TraceId = p.TraceId WHERE $__timeFilter(c.Timestamp) AND $__timeFilter(p.Timestamp) AND p.ServiceName != c.ServiceName GROUP BY source, target LIMIT 200

SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID, ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName, Timestamp AS startTime, Duration / 1000000 AS duration, SpanAttributes AS tags FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId = (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend' AND SpanName = 'POST /api/checkout' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY startTime LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Where checkout requests spend time
panels.description: The 100 latest checkout requests merged by call path; the queued order work that runs after the answer is left out.

queries.query: WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'frontend' AND SpanName = 'POST /api/checkout' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100), t AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, concat(ServiceName, ': ', SpanName) AS label, Duration / 1e6 AS ms FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM roots) AND SpanName != 'process_order'), tree AS (SELECT TraceId, SpanId, 0 AS level, label AS path, '' AS parent_path, label, ms FROM t WHERE ParentSpanId = '' UNION ALL SELECT t.TraceId, t.SpanId, tree.level + 1, concat(tree.path, char(1), t.label), tree.path, t.label, t.ms FROM t INNER JOIN tree ON t.TraceId = tree.TraceId AND t.ParentSpanId = tree.SpanId), agg AS (SELECT path, any(parent_path) AS parent_path, any(level) AS level, any(label) AS label, sum(ms) AS value FROM tree GROUP BY path) SELECT a.level AS level, a.value AS value, greatest(a.value - ifNull(c.child_value, 0), 0) AS self, a.label AS label FROM agg AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_path, sum(value) AS child_value FROM agg GROUP BY parent_path) AS c ON a.path = c.parent_path ORDER BY a.path

panels.title: Checkout flow
panels.description: Spans each service handled in the time range, drawn as the path a checkout takes.

queries.query: SELECT countIf(ServiceName = 'frontend') AS frontend, countIf(ServiceName = 'checkout') AS checkout, countIf(ServiceName = 'payments') AS payments FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.title: What else is around the shop?
Where the services run
panels.description: Spans per service in the time range. The demo shop runs on one host, so the places are only examples.

queries.query: SELECT ServiceName AS service, multiIf(ServiceName = 'frontend', 51.5, ServiceName = 'checkout', 50.1, 48.9) AS lat, multiIf(ServiceName = 'frontend', -0.1, ServiceName = 'checkout', 8.7, 2.3) AS lon, count() AS spans FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY service ORDER BY service

panels.title: About these panels
panels.content:
From **How are requests and load spread out?** down, this dashboard shows one panel of every type SlashObserve draws, on the demo shop's own data.

The news panel needs github.com on the outbound allowlist in Settings, and it says so until an Admin allows it.

Pick **Edit** on a panel to see its query and change its type.
